devon.k: Hi all — first day snag. I accepted the GitHub org invite but I can only see public repos. Trying to clone infra/ci gives 404. I did SSO and set up TOTP 2FA. Any ideas?

it-ops: welcome! quick check: in the org People page does your entry say Member or Outside collaborator?

devon.k: It shows Member, but `gh repo list redwood-inference --private` returns nothing. web UI still 404 on private repo.

zack.dev: If org shows Member but you can't see repos, often it's a browser session issue — you might be logged into a different GH account in the browser than the gh CLI. Run `gh auth status` and `gh api /user --jq .login`.

devon.k: `gh auth status` -> Logged in to GitHub.com as devon-k; SSO active. Web shows my avatar as devon.k though.

it-ops: ok. another common problem: multiple accounts with similar emails + browser cookie/session caching. Try opening an incognito window, sign in to the correct account, then accept any pending org prompts (authorize SAML) and check again.

devon.k: I tried incognito and now I can see the repo list. I think the original accept happened while my personal account was logged in and the cookie stuck, even though the org shows Member for my work account.

hr-ops: thanks for flagging — we sometimes see forwarded onboarding emails cause people to click invites while a personal session is active. we'll note in the offer checklist to recommend using incognito or desktop and verifying the avatar before clicking the accept link.

zack.dev: FYI if you ever see inconsistent state after re-auth, run `gh auth refresh` and clear github.com cookies. Also confirm Settings -> Organizations -> redwood-inference shows SAML authorized.

onboard-bot: Ticket #5112 created: "browser session account mixup blocked repo access" assigned to infra-admins. ETA: 4 hours.

devon.k: All good now after incognito sign-in and authorizing SAML. can clone and opened my first PR. thanks! :tada:

it-ops: great — welcome aboard. if it reappears DM us and we'll check org membership and SCIM logs.
